title: BUGFIX — Fix init-hetzner.sh .env template: add missing required + optional env vars
rationale: pre-deploy-check.ts (Sprint 1160) requires TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, OWNER_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, OLLAMA_HOST, and VAULT_LOCAL_MODEL_POWER — but the .env template written by init-hetzner.sh was missing VAULT_LOCAL_MODEL_POWER. A fresh Hetzner init would pass PM2 start but fail pre-deploy-check with FAIL on env:VAULT_LOCAL_MODEL_POWER. Also missing: PAYMEE_API_KEY and MINIMAX_API_KEY (optional, used by Achiri paid tiers). Fixed: added all 4 vars with correct grouping and comments matching pre-deploy-check categories (required vs optional).

tasks.description: Add VAULT_LOCAL_MODEL_POWER=qwen3:4b (required), PAYMEE_API_KEY= and MINIMAX_API_KEY= (optional) to .env template in init-hetzner.sh. Reorganised with section comments matching pre-deploy-check.ts categories. Validated: template now covers all 4 REQUIRED_ENV and all 4 OPTIONAL_ENV vars from pre-deploy-check.ts.
